sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa: Get Information / Do I need visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.e-gov.kg service identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and directs users to choose country, travel-document type and visa type to determine the available mechanism.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Choose your Country, Type of Travel Document and Visa Type.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa country visa-regime selector backend
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: This is the live same-origin endpoint called by the MFA eVisa selector for a selected passport-issuing country. It returned country-specific regime rows during this review, but later refused connections.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa free regime — Ordinary passport — up to 30 days.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa official portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official portal identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as operator and describes online eVisa issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronic visa grants the same right to enter Kyrgyzstan as an ordinary sticker visa.

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers regulation on entry and stay of foreign citizens
sources.publisher: Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Cabinet legal-acts portal publishes the foreign-citizen entry and stay regulation; it requires a visa unless a treaty or legal act establishes otherwise.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign citizens enter the Kyrgyz Republic with an entry visa, unless otherwise provided.

policies.title: Albania ordinary passports: 30-day visa-free regime
policies.summary: The MFA eVisa selector's country-specific live backend response directly identifies Albania's ordinary-passport visa-free regime as up to 30 days.
conditions: The result is an ordinary-passport baseline and records a stay of up to 30 days.
It does not establish work, residence, registration, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document treatment; normal entry and individual-admissibility checks remain applicable.
The response also labels a facilitated visa regime, but that label does not by itself identify a tourist eVisa route and is not normalized here.
